restaurants.name: Quintonil
restaurants.description: Jorge Vallejo and Alejandra Flores's Polanco tasting room: Mexican ingredients, botanical precision, high demand.
restaurants.address: Av. Isaac Newton 55, Polanco IV Secc, Miguel Hidalgo, 11560 Ciudad de México

reservation.tips: Book only via the restaurant reservation flow. Email is not accepted. Deposit required. Tell them dietary needs at booking — vegan, vegetarian, and pescatarian adaptations exist; they cannot exclude corn, chile, or onion.

avoid_for: Groups larger than the room allows
editorial.ambiance: Two rooms: one darker and contained, one brighter. Service is formal without theater.
editorial.ideal_moment: Weeknight dinner if you can get it; lunch is the more obtainable slot.
editorial.visitor_type: Travelers who plan weeks out; locals celebrating.

faqs.question: Is Quintonil worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes if you want a current, high-precision Mexican tasting menu in Polanco and you can secure a reservation. It is not a spontaneous meal.

faqs.question: How much does Quintonil cost?
faqs.answer: The August 2026 tasting menu is 6,090 MXN per person before pairings. Beverage pairings run 2,175–8,450 MXN. Confirm on quintonil.com; prices change.

faqs.question: Is Quintonil good for tourists?
faqs.answer: Yes, if tourists book far ahead through the official reservation flow. Walk-ins are not a plan.

faqs.question: Does Quintonil have vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: The tasting menu can be adapted for vegan, vegetarian, and pescatarian diets if declared at reservation. Corn, chile, and onion cannot be excluded.

restaurants.name: Contramar
restaurants.description: Gabriela Cámara's Roma Norte seafood room. Lunch is the point. The pescado a la talla is the reason people return.
restaurants.address: Durango 200, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, 06700 Ciudad de México

reservation.tips: Weekend lunch fills first. Weekday 12:00–14:00 is the realistic walk-in window. The room is loud at peak. Closes at 20:00 — this is not a late dinner.

editorial.ambiance: Bright, packed, coastal energy inland. Conversation competes with the room.
editorial.ideal_moment: Saturday 13:00 if booked; Tuesday 12:30 if not.
editorial.visitor_type: Almost everyone — tourists, locals, business lunch if they accept noise.

menus.notes: À la carte. Confirm live prices in the room. Vegetarian is not the point of this kitchen.

faqs.question: Is Contramar worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes for a Mexico City lunch. It is still one of the most reliable seafood rooms in Roma Norte if you accept noise and a wait at peak.

faqs.question: How much does Contramar cost?
faqs.answer: Plan $$ — a serious lunch without tasting-menu pricing. Exact item prices are confirmed at the table; they are not stably published.

faqs.question: Is Contramar good for tourists?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book OpenTable for weekend lunch. It is a tourist magnet and still a local lunch habit.

faqs.question: Does Contramar have vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: This is a fish and seafood restaurant. Vegetarians should pick another table.

restaurants.name: Expendio de Maíz
restaurants.description: Jesús Salas Tornés's Roma Norte corn kitchen: no menu, no reservations, cash, communal tables, food until you stop.
restaurants.address: Av. Yucatán 84, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, 06700 Ciudad de México

reservation.tips: No reservations. Put your name on the on-site list. Arrive early. Bring cash. State allergies when seated. Weekend waits can run hours.

editorial.ambiance: Open kitchen on the street side, four communal tables, no signage theater. The food is the system.
editorial.ideal_moment: Weekday late morning. Do not sandwich this between two timed bookings.

menus.name: No written menu
menus.notes: Kitchen sends antojitos until you stop. Heirloom corn, tortillas, sopes, huaraches. Cash only.

items.name: Nixtamal tortillas to order
Sopes / huaraches / tacos as sent
Tableside salsas

faqs.question: Is Expendio de Maíz worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes if you will wait and pay cash for corn cooking with no menu. No if you need a reservation, a card, or a private table.

faqs.question: How much does Expendio de Maíz cost?
faqs.answer: $$, paid in cash, no published prix fixe. You eat until you stop, so the check tracks appetite.

faqs.question: Is Expendio de Maíz good for tourists?
faqs.answer: Yes for tourists who can handle a waitlist and Spanish at the counter. It is not a concierge booking.

faqs.question: Does Expendio de Maíz have vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: Yes — declare restrictions when you sit. The kitchen builds plates to order around nixtamal. Confirm meat and lard in the moment.
